page: Microsoft Azure F8alds_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine operating under Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 x86_64 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz, provisioned with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs without multithreading (1 thread per core). Memory is configured at 16.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio (2.0 GB per core). For high-throughput local operations, the server integrates a bundled 945 GB NVMe SSD, while GPU acceleration is not present.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate standout single-thread compute capabilities, driven by high clock rates and architectural instruction set extensions including AVX-512 (f, vnni, and bf16). In stress-ng single-core testing, the instance scored 3770.68, placing it in the top 10%. Single-threaded compression also excelled, hitting 41.29 GB/sec in gzip and 18.23 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression (both in the top 10%). On small language model inference (135M model), it achieved a top-tier text generation rate of 393.31 tokens/sec and strong prompt processing at 2666.18 tokens/sec. Conversely, multi-core throughput and memory-bound metrics align with the mid-tier category, yielding 30004.31 in multi-core stress-ng, 24.32 million Redis SET ops/sec, and 19.2 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

The primary tradeoff of the F8alds_v7 lies in its lean memory configuration relative to its core count, which limits concurrency for memory-dense datasets. However, it delivers strong cost efficiency for compute-heavy workloads that require dedicated single-thread execution speed rather than high RAM capacity. Equipped with fast local NVMe storage and dedicated vCPUs, the server is well matched for batch processing, automated CI/CD builds, compression pipelines, video encoding, web serving, and lightweight machine learning inference.
description: Microsoft Azure F8alds_v7 is a compute-optimized instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor offering 8 dedicated cores (8 vCPUs) at 4.5 GHz, 16.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 945 GB local NVMe SSD. It features extensive instruction set support including AVX-512 extensions and cryptographic instructions, but lacks GPU acceleration. In benchmark evaluations, the F8alds_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, achieving 3770.68 in stress-ng single-core and fast throughput in single-threaded gzip compression and lightweight LLM text generation. While memory capacity is constrained at 2.0 GB per vCPU, its dedicated high-frequency cores and high-speed local disk provide strong cost efficiency for CPU-bound tasks. The instance is suited for CI/CD compilation, data compression pipelines, web application serving, and CPU-based inference workloads.
